Gulmarg Implements Odd-Even Vehicle Rule to Ease Traffic and Protect Environment

The popular tourist destination of Gulmarg has introduced an odd-even vehicle restriction system on a trial basis. The rule, which applies daily from 8 am to 8 pm, aims to alleviate traffic congestion and safeguard the local environment. This marks the first time such a measure has been implemented in Gulmarg.
